subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. B sits third to the left of D. A sits second to the left of G. D is the immediate neighbour of both C and A. E is not an immediate neighbour of B. How many people sit between E and F when counted from the right of E?
solution: **Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1. B sits third to the left of D. 2. D is the immediate neighbour of both C and A. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8486f9a2c97456480e0186a16389c60a4f5c4bb4814c65f767349272ed184cea.png] 3. A sits second to the left of G. The above statement cannot be satisfied in case I, so it is eliminated.
